scope: Arms and fixed hands only. All 40 non-arm collision geoms retain exact source attributes/body attachments and automatic contact masks; pelvis, legs, feet, torso, neck and head are unchanged.
supersedes: The prior whole-body 27-collider experiment; this revision preserves the lower body and simplifies only arms/hands.
contact_policy: Original non-arm automatic contacts preserved. Optimized arm masks are zero and scene_simplified.xml declares selected arm contact pairs.
preserved: All body/inertial/joint/passive/numerical properties and all 37 visual meshes/colors
Complete source non-arm collider definitions, including names, shapes, transforms, RGBA, groups and masks
Original default/articulated model files, source evidence, assets and previews
limitations: No measured runtime speedup, exhaustive visual-mesh containment or hardware contact calibration is claimed.
Merged forearm/pitch proxies are conservative relative to the source collision envelopes and can contact earlier than the old narrower shaft segments.
The wrist/hand proxy preserves and contains the original collision envelope; the original collision envelope does not cover every point of the detailed native-hand visual mesh.
No MJX runtime, PD/controller, URDF or Workbench support is introduced.

arm_colliders.name: left_shoulder_housing_collision

verification.probe_scope: Reference; independent shoulder-yaw, elbow and all wrist joint lower/upper limits; combined extreme pose on both arms. All old arm collision envelopes remain contained by new proxies within 1e-8 m tolerance.
verification.shoulder_yaw_merge: The retained source upper-arm capsule is collinear with the shoulder-yaw axis and invariant to that rotation, allowing attachment of the combined shaft to shoulder-roll without a moving-axis error.
verification.wrist_hand_merge: Yaw housing and native hand share a fixed transform; the combined proxy attaches to wrist-yaw, never across independently moving wrist-pitch/yaw joints.
